title: JourneyRunner composes interlockings without executing trains or wagons (Bun)

facts.note: Bun consumer repository (Bun runtime/lockfile/config). TypeScript alone does NOT qualify; a non-Bun TypeScript consumer is out of scope.
Presence of at least one journey topology document enables the obligation (source prerequisite).
A Station Master composition root must already exist (source exception: PLAN-stage repositories without one carry no obligation).

Family detector OUTPUTS, not activation prerequisites: once the three prerequisites above hold, the detector runs over src/trains/** even when src/trains/** or JourneyRunner does not exist yet, and reports these findings.

fires: Bun consumer with a Station Master composition root and plan/_journeys/*.yaml, where JourneyRunner (or all of src/trains/**) is missing.

Bun consumer with a Station Master composition root and plan/_journeys/*.yaml, whose JourneyRunner imports a wagon module, calls runTrain(...), references TrainRunner, or loops over train.sequence as an executor.
Bun consumer with a Station Master composition root and plan/_journeys/*.yaml, whose JourneyRunner constructs an InterlockingRunner from a hardcoded literal path.
Bun consumer with a Station Master composition root and plan/_journeys/*.yaml, whose JourneyRunner carries or mutates Cargo.
Bun consumer with a Station Master composition root and plan/_journeys/*.yaml, whose JourneyRunner never parses a journey declaration or never references InterlockingRunner.
doesNotFire: A Bun consumer with no plan/_journeys topology documents.
A Bun consumer still in the PLAN stage with no Station Master composition root.
A non-Bun consumer (including a TypeScript consumer on another runtime), even with plan/_journeys topology.
InterlockingRunner delegating its selected train to TrainRunner, or TrainRunner iterating train.sequence to execute wagon steps (their own responsibilities).

given: A Bun consumer with a Station Master composition root declares one or more journey topology documents under plan/_journeys/ (whether or not src/trains/** or a JourneyRunner exists yet)
when: the journey topology is present, which enables the obligation on the runtime under src/trains/**
then: You MUST ship a JourneyRunner under src/trains/** that acts only as continuation control: it reads and parses the declared journey topology and delegates every routing decision to InterlockingRunner using declaration-derived values, never executing trains, wagons or Cargo itself.
prefer: If no JourneyRunner exists, add one under src/trains/ that reads the supplied journey declaration; its absence is a violation, not an option.

The intended call model is: Station Master -> JourneyRunner -> InterlockingRunner.resolve/execute(...) -> TrainRunner.execute(selectedTrainId, ...) -> inspect declared continuation/terminal -> next InterlockingRunner ... (TrainRunner.execute is called by InterlockingRunner, never by JourneyRunner).
InterlockingRunner selects exactly one train and delegates it to TrainRunner; JourneyRunner only decides which interlocking is entered next per the declared topology.
avoid: Constructing an InterlockingRunner from a hardcoded literal path.
Referencing TrainRunner, importing wagon modules, or calling runTrain(...) from JourneyRunner.
Looping over train.sequence as an executor in JourneyRunner.
Carrying or mutating Cargo in JourneyRunner.
unless: No plan/_journeys topology: no JourneyRunner obligation.
No Station Master composition root yet (PLAN stage): no JourneyRunner obligation, as coder.bun.interlocking-runner-exists owes no InterlockingRunner before one.
why: Each layer owns only its responsibility (JourneyRunner: continuation control, never the train step loop; InterlockingRunner: local route selection; TrainRunner: sole wagon-step executor), so topology cannot bypass routing or duplicate train execution.
evidence: class JourneyRunner exists under src/trains/** whenever the activation prerequisites hold.
JourneyRunner source shows reading and parsing of a journey declaration and references InterlockingRunner.
No literal-path InterlockingRunner construction, TrainRunner reference, wagon import, runTrain(...) call, train.sequence executor loop or Cargo handling in JourneyRunner.
verifier_detail: Enforces the Bun runtime boundary introduced by planner journey topology. Presence of plan/_journeys/**/*.yaml enables the obligation; no phase or edit-event gate. The detector must run (and report missing runner) even when src/trains/** is absent.

Family detector: looks for class JourneyRunner under src/trains/**; requires evidence the runtime reads and parses a journey declaration; requires a reference to InterlockingRunner; rejects literal InterlockingRunner construction; rejects direct TrainRunner/wagon/Cargo execution patterns (TrainRunner references, wagon imports, runTrain(...), train.sequence executor loops, Cargo carry/mutation).
metadata: severity 4, disposition strict (as stated in source; no further enforcement semantics implied here).

Terms: journey_runner = the runtime continuation-control layer that traverses declared journey topology between interlockings; boundary = JourneyRunner -> InterlockingRunner -> TrainRunner, each layer owns only its declared responsibility.

Existence obligation (source statement): a Bun consumer that declares one or more journey topology documents under plan/_journeys/ MUST ship a JourneyRunner under src/trains/**; same two exceptions apply. Carried operatively in then.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.

additions.text: Existence of JourneyRunner (S006) and its continuation-only boundary (S007) are stated as one deliverable in then: ship a JourneyRunner that only does continuation control. No split is proposed, so the MUST-ship requirement stays operative for the coder.
additions.justification: Auditor required the existence requirement to remain mandatory until an operative split rule carries it; both describe a single artifact checked by the same family detector.

additions.text: Parenthetical in prefer[1] clarifying that TrainRunner.execute is invoked by InterlockingRunner, not JourneyRunner.
additions.justification: Derived from S007/S008 (JourneyRunner must not reference TrainRunner; InterlockingRunner delegates to TrainRunner); prevents misreading the flattened call chain. No new obligation.

additions.text: finding facts marked needs_new_observer as detector outputs (not prerequisites); doesNotFire examples for non-Bun consumers and for InterlockingRunner/TrainRunner own responsibilities.
additions.justification: Required activation structure; derived from source scope ('A Bun consumer') and call model, no new obligations.
